cohort: The study participants were traumatically injured females aged 15 to 55 identified from the ACS-TQIP national trauma database between 2020 and 2021.
finding: Pregnant trauma patients are more often victims of firearm violence, sustaining more severe thoracic and abdominal injuries, which leads to increased interventions, complications, longer ICU stays, and higher rates of unplanned ICU returns, although there was no significant difference in overall mortality compared to non-pregnant trauma patients after matching.
